title: Matched combat
description: An animations/matched_combat (or database/matched, database/trigger) .bin file: paired animations, such as one unit killing another. WARHAMMER III's version 1 only stores each participant's team, start and end state, uk3, uk4, and the animation and mount file of its first entity; the other fields must stay as they are (empty id, weight and blend time 0), or saving is refused.

version.description: File format version: 1 in WARHAMMER III and Three Kingdoms (different layouts), 3 in later games.

id.description: Name of the matched animation (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

participants.description: The units taking part, usually two.

state.description: Whether the participant is alive or dead.

entity_info.description: The participant's possible animations, each with a selection weight. WARHAMMER III stores exactly one, with one entity.

selection_weight.description: Relative chance of picking this bundle (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

metadata_filenames.description: Pack paths of .meta files (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

blend_in_time.description: Blend time into the animation, in seconds (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

equipment_display.description: Not stored in WARHAMMER III files.

filters.description: Conditions on the participant (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

uk.description: Unknown (not stored in WARHAMMER III files).

mount_filename.description: Pack path of the mount's .anim file (WARHAMMER III).

end.description: State at the end, e.g. Dead for the one who is killed.
